description: Data + logic layer for 'any emoji' reactions, with no visible UI change yet. Generate a bundled static emoji dataset (public/emoji-data.js, Emoji 15.0, base emoji without skin tones) via a dev script; make isAllowedReactionEmoji accept exactly the dataset (plus the legacy 6) so routes/chat.js:359, buildReactionList, buildLastReaction and wiadomosci-page.js threadPreviewText all accept any picker emoji; replace EMOJI_ORDER.get with a total-order orderOf(); fix the 'Reakcja reakcja' aria-label fallback; add a quote-safe attribute escaper. CHAT_REACTIONS / CHAT_REACTION_EMOJI stay unchanged so chat-reactions.spec.js keeps passing untouched. Independent of the UI; FEAT-002 depends on it.
steps: Create scripts/build-emoji-data.js: args --in <local emoji-test.txt> or default fetch of https://unicode.org/Public/emoji/15.0/emoji-test.txt, --out <path>. Parse '# group:' headers and lines '<cps> ; fully-qualified # <emoji> E15.0 <name>'. Keep fully-qualified only, drop group 'Component', drop any emoji containing U+1F3FB..U+1F3FF, assert max code points <= 16 (DB VARCHAR(16)) and uniqueness. Emit a dual-module IIFE with a header comment (source URL, Emoji version, generator command): window.EmojiData / module.exports = { version: '15.0', categories: [{ id, label (Polish), icon, emoji: 'space separated string' }] }. Category ids/labels/icons: smileys 'Buźki i emocje' 😀; people 'Ludzie' 🧑; animals 'Zwierzęta i natura' 🐻; food 'Jedzenie i picie' 🍔; travel 'Podróże i miejsca' 🚗; activities 'Aktywności' ⚽; objects 'Przedmioty' 💡; symbols 'Symbole' 🔣; flags 'Flagi' 🏁.
Run it to produce public/emoji-data.js; record emoji count and byte size (raw; gzip via node zlib) in findings.

public/chat-reactions.js core (lines ~29-62, ~155-166): load EmojiData (require('./emoji-data') when module.exports exists, else root.EmojiData; tolerate absence -> legacy 6 only). Build ALLOWED Set and ORDER Map (legacy 6 keep indices 0-5, every other emoji 100 + dataset index). Add orderOf(emoji). Rewrite isAllowedReactionEmoji = typeof string && length <= 32 && ALLOWED.has. Rewrite sortByAllowlist with orderOf. Add CHAT_QUICK_REACTIONS = CHAT_REACTIONS.slice(0, 5). Export CHAT_QUICK_REACTIONS and orderOf in `core` and in root.ChatReactions. Do NOT alter CHAT_REACTIONS or CHAT_REACTION_EMOJI. Update the stale comment at lines 31-34.

public/chat-reactions.js UI part: nextChipAfter (~307-316) uses orderOf; chipLabel (~203-207) falls back to 'Reakcja ' + emoji instead of the generic 'reakcja'; add module-local escAttr (escapes & < > " ') and use it for all attribute values in chipHtml and addButtonHtml (keep esc() for text nodes). Never build selectors from emoji.

Comment-only updates: routes/chat.js above line 359 (membership spans the full dataset); lib/chat.js 44-52 and scripts/init-db.js 113-117 (VARCHAR(16) fits the longest dataset sequence; build script asserts it). No DDL change, no migration.

Create tests/e2e/chat-emoji-picker.spec.js (API + Node-level tests only in this feature; UI tests are added by FEAT-002). Accepted via POST /api/wiadomosci/messages/4/reactions: 🎉, 🙏, ZWJ 👩‍❤️‍💋‍👨, flag 🇵🇱, England flag tag sequence, keycap #️⃣ -> each toggles added then removed, response reactions keys exactly ['count','emoji','mine']. Rejected with 400: '', 'a', '', '"', '🎉🎉', '🎉\n', '\u0000', 5000-char string, 👍🏽, number, array, object, missing body. Node-level via require('../../public/chat-reactions'): buildReactionList orders [❤️, 🙏, 🎉] deterministically and drops junk, buildLastReaction accepts 🎉 and rejects junk, EmojiData has 9 categories with unique emoji each <= 16 code points. Restore demo state in every test.
acceptance_criteria: public/emoji-data.js exists, is generated by scripts/build-emoji-data.js, has 9 categories and roughly 1,300-1,500 unique emoji, none with skin-tone modifiers, each <= 16 code points

POST /api/wiadomosci/messages/:id/reactions returns 200 for any dataset emoji (incl. ZWJ, flag, keycap, tag-sequence) and 400 'Nieprawidłowa reakcja' for HTML, control chars, multi-emoji, empty, oversized and non-string input
Chips for non-legacy emoji sort after the legacy six in a stable order (no NaN sort); existing chip order for the legacy six is unchanged
A chip for an unnamed emoji has aria-label 'Reakcja <emoji>: N osób/osoba/osoby. ...' (never 'Reakcja reakcja')
All attribute values emitted by chipHtml/addButtonHtml pass through escAttr
tests/e2e/chat-reactions.spec.js passes without modification; tests/e2e/chat-emoji-picker.spec.js (API/Node part) passes
package.json and package-lock.json unchanged; no new network origin
verification: node --check public/chat-reactions.js ; node --check public/emoji-data.js ; node --check scripts/build-emoji-data.js

git -P diff --stat shows only: scripts/build-emoji-data.js, public/emoji-data.js, public/chat-reactions.js, routes/chat.js (comment), lib/chat.js (comment), scripts/init-db.js (comment), tests/e2e/chat-emoji-picker.spec.js
findings: Committed 85c23f3 on feat/emoji-picker-1 (not pushed). Unicode download worked (fetch of unicode.org emoji-test.txt, Emoji 15.0, status counts: fully-qualified 3655). DATASET: 1870 unique emoji (NOT the 1,300-1,500 the plan estimated; the figure is simply what 15.0 fully-qualified minus skin-tone sequences yields; max length 8 code points). Per category: smileys 166, people 363, animals 152, food 133, travel 218, activities 85, objects 261, symbols 223, flags 269. public/emoji-data.js = 14567 bytes raw (LF), 5894 bytes gzip. Generated with 'node scripts/build-emoji-data.js --out public/emoji-data.js'. LATER-STEP NOTES: (1) wiadomosci.html does NOT load emoji-data.js yet, so in the browser ChatReactions still fails closed to the legacy six until FEAT-002 adds <script src=/emoji-data.js?v=1> BEFORE chat-reactions.js (chat-reactions.js reads root.EmojiData at load time; load order matters). (2) Exports now available: ChatReactions.CHAT_QUICK_REACTIONS (first 5 legacy), ChatReactions.orderOf, same on require(). (3) New module-local escAttr in chat-reactions.js used for chipHtml/addButtonHtml attributes; chipLabel falls back to 'Reakcja <emoji>: ...'. (4) emoji-data.js assigns window.EmojiData only when window exists and module.exports in Node (no global pollution). (5) Spec tests/e2e/chat-emoji-picker.spec.js has 9 tests (API, chip markup, Node logic); the chip-markup test loads /emoji-data.js and re-runs /chat-reactions.js via addScriptTag because the page does not load the dataset yet; once FEAT-002 loads it in the HTML that workaround is harmless but can be dropped. FEAT-002 UI tests should add the real-DOM aria-label check. (6) Repo working tree is CRLF with autocrlf: new files were written LF and git warns 'LF will be replaced by CRLF'; harmless. (7) Comment-only edits in routes/chat.js, lib/chat.js, scripts/init-db.js. Verification: node --check on the three JS files OK; 'npm run test:e2e -- chat-emoji-picker chat-reactions' = 20 passed (chat-reactions.spec.js untouched). package.json / package-lock.json / home-page.css untouched. Deviation: git diff --stat file list matches the plan exactly (7 files); none beyond.
